name: W7 - PowerShell launched by non-interactive parent (CAR-2014-04-003, tuned)
description: MITRE CAR-2014-04-003 'PowerShell Execution' adapted to the QazLogistics lab: PowerShell (also renamed copies, by OriginalFileName) whose parent is not explorer.exe, minus three allow-listed (parent + exact command line) pairs, plus explorer.exe-launched PowerShell with hidden/encoded flags (.lnk phishing). threat-hunting-project1, week 7.
query:
FROM th-w7-sysmon METADATA _id, _index, _version
| WHERE event_id == 1
  AND (TO_LOWER(original_file_name) IN ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.dll")
       OR ENDS_WITH(TO_LOWER(image), "\\powershell.exe") OR ENDS_WITH(TO_LOWER(image), "\\pwsh.exe"))
| EVAL p = TO_LOWER(parent_image), c = TO_LOWER(command_line)
| WHERE NOT (p == """c:\windows\system32\svchost.exe""" AND c == """powershell.exe -noprofile -file c:\it\inventory.ps1""")
  AND NOT (p == """c:\program files\manageengine\uems_agent\bin\dcagentservice.exe""" AND c == "powershell.exe -noninteractive -encodedcommand rwblahqalqbtaguacgb2agkaywblaa==")
  AND NOT (ENDS_WITH(p, "\\code.exe") AND user == "o.li" AND c IN ("powershell.exe -nologo", "powershell.exe -nologo -noexit"))
| WHERE NOT ENDS_WITH(p, "\\explorer.exe")
     OR c RLIKE ".* -(e|en|enc|encodedcommand) .*"
     OR c RLIKE ".* -w(indowstyle)? +hidden.*"
| KEEP _id, _index, _version, @timestamp, hostname, user, parent_image, image, command_line
false_positives: New IT automation that starts PowerShell from a service - add (parent + exact command line) to the allow-list after review
Users who start PowerShell with -WindowStyle Hidden from a desktop shortcut
author: Kazhymukan Boris (threat-hunting-project1 group)
